note: De-identified queue of survey evidence about plants that are NOT in the database (M54). Written by tools/survey_to_claims.py from the private export; ids are the anonymous respondent ids. Entries are respondents' own words, kept verbatim: selection reasons (d1, no basis) and practitioner notes (d2, with the basis the respondent ticked). NOTHING here is a claim, a verified plant trait, or evidence of compatibility or screening performance; no plant file is created from it. An entry becomes a claim only after the taxon is confirmed, the plant is added, and a researcher maps the note.
